{{Quote|Not ''eaten''&hellip;your ''Millennium Falcon'' was merely hauled to the mud lake's ''bottom!'' Escape pods which carried me&hellip;my men&hellip;suffered the ''same!''|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref>}}
A sizable '''mud lake''' existed on the surface of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The lake's [[Water/Legends|waters]] were home to giant [[lake worm]]s, which were attracted in some form to mechanized objects. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Worm/Legends|worms]] dragged the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], down to the lake's depths.
